pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, quiet night atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
A lonely road inside the dark night
even the stars are hiding somewhere
in this quiet space between breaths

when your memory rises softly
the air returns inside my chest

[Pre-Chorus]
your warmth arrived without a word
melting the winter in my heart

[Chorus]
your smile becomes the strength I hold
even from far away it still reaches me
your light quietly falls on my path
and I begin to live again

[Verse 2]
behind the clouds a hidden sun waits
the world feels heavy but you move like wind
when I hear your voice everything slows

deep scars slowly fade away
your fingertips feel like quiet magic

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, reflective and hopeful)

[Bridge]
the night remains but it feels softer now
a small light stays beside my steps
breathing slowly, I keep walking

[Chorus]
your smile becomes the strength I hold
even from far away it still reaches me
your light quietly falls on my path
and I begin to live again

[Outro]
(piano instrumental fading gently, soft hopeful tone)

pkg.youtubeDescription:
🌙 A quiet night walk turns when someone else’s warmth arrives without needing a speech.

🤍 This piece holds loneliness gently, then lets breath come back through small light and a reachable smile.

🎹 Narrative piano indie—intimate vocal, flowing piano as the main voice, minimal air, no heavy drums, only a mid-song solo that opens the room.

💬 If a soft return ever found you on a hard road, tell me where you were when the quiet changed. I read the comments.
